hooks.command: PLUGIN_PYTHON=; for candidate in python3 python; do if "$candidate" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then PLUGIN_PYTHON=$candidate; break; fi; done; if test -n "$PLUGIN_PYTHON"; then "$PLUGIN_PYTHON" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory.py" hook-capture --plugin-data "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Evidence Memory: capture unavailable; configure a working Python 3.9 or later executable."}'; fi
